hypothesis: The rejected v10 head learned a useful low-resolution/noise direction, but a fixed probability blend diluted it. A label-blind noise detector can use v10 only for the exact severe-noise regime while preserving the verified v6/v9 path elsewhere.

router.input: RGB pixels after aspect-preserving resize to 224 and center crop, before normalization

screen_order: Verify shared-backbone logits reproduce the separate-model FP16 contract.
Run the frozen router on already-consumed internal, NTIRE and Community gates without changing threshold or heads.
Reject without opening a fresh gate if clean AUC drops by more than 0.002, any clean worst-pair AUC drops by more than 0.01, or sigma-0.10 AUC drops on either independent gate.
Only after all screens pass, freeze and open a byte-disjoint promotion gate.
forbidden_actions: Do not change the 0.055 threshold using any consumed evaluation row.
Do not choose another head blend from the rejected v10 gate.
Do not train, tune, calibrate or threshold on organizer demo-only COCO or DALL-E Advanced data.
Do not claim promotion unless every predeclared check passes on a new disjoint gate.
rejection_reason: Noise AUC improved by 0.015895843505859375 on the fresh gate, below the predeclared 0.05 minimum; five other checks passed.
